plain.li: [greetings,warm,colony:known,!colony:renowned] We have heard a little of your colony, {WRITER}, and all of it good.
[greetings,cordial,colony:known,!colony:renowned,theirLowtech] Your colony's name has reached us, {WRITER}. We are glad to put a hand to it.
[greetings,cordial,colony:known,!colony:renowned,theirHightech] Your colony is {RENOWN}, we hear. Good to have a letter to go with it.
[greetings,cool,colony:known] We know your colony's name. We will see whether you live up to it.
[greetings,warm,colony:renowned] We know your colony's name here, {WRITER}. A letter from it is read twice.
[greetings,cordial,colony:renowned,theirLowtech] The name of your colony has reached our hall. It is good to have a letter from one of you.
[greetings,cordial,colony:renowned,theirHightech] Your colony's name is known here, {WRITER}. Good to hear from it directly.
[greetings,curt,colony:renowned] Your colony's name is known here. That earns you an answer, no more.
[greetings,warm,colony:wide] Your colony is {RENOWN}, {WRITER}. We are glad it has written to us.
[greetings,cordial,colony:wide,theirHightech] Your colony is {RENOWN}, so your letter was read first.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:healers] We hear your colony is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Our sick are glad of such neighbors.
[greetings,warm,colony:knownfor:hosts] Your colony is known for {KNOWNFOR}, and your letter reads like it.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:fighters,theirLowtech] Our fighters speak of your colony, known for {KNOWNFOR} as it is. They would rather have it beside them than against them.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:traders,theirHightech] Your colony's known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. We'll read your letters with care.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:makers] Your colony is known for {KNOWNFOR} here. If you ever have work to spare, our traders will want to see it.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:faithful,theirLowtech] Your colony is known for {KNOWNFOR} even here. May your faith keep you as you keep it.
[greetings,cordial,colony:knownfor:faithful,theirHightech] Your colony is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. We respect that, whatever we believe.
[news,cordial,colony:knownfor:traders] Here is our news. Our traders will want to hear yours, from a colony known for {KNOWNFOR}.
[news,cordial,colony:renowned] Here is our news, and you may like to know your colony is {RENOWN}.
[help,warm,colony:renowned] For your colony, we send {HELP} gladly.
[help,cordial,colony:knownfor:healers] We can spare some {HELP}. A colony known for {KNOWNFOR} will use it well.
[help,cordial,colony:known] We can send {HELP}. Your colony's name is known to us, and that counts for something.
[help,refusal,colony:renowned] Your colony's name is known here, but we cannot spare {HELP} now.
[invitation,warm,colony:renowned] An invitation from your colony is not one to turn down. We will come.
[invitation,warm,colony:knownfor:hosts] A colony known for {KNOWNFOR} has asked us to visit. We will come, and hungry.
[invitation,cordial,colony:known] We would like to see the colony behind the name. We will come.
[invitation,cool,colony:known] We have your invitation. Your colony's name is known here, but we will not travel now.
[warning,warm,colony:renowned] A warning from your colony we take to heart. Thank you.
[warning,cordial,colony:known] We have your warning, and your colony's name gives it weight.
[condolences,warm,colony:renowned] Your letter means more coming from your colony. Thank you for thinking of us.
[condolences,cordial,colony:known] Thank you for your words, {WRITER}. Your colony's name is known here, and now so is its kindness.
[greetings,cool,colony:infamous] We have your letter. Your colony's name is not one we are glad to see on it.
[greetings,curt,colony:infamous,theirHightech] Your letter came. Your colony is {RENOWN}, so keep it brief.
[greetings,cool,colony:infamous,theirLowtech] We have your letter. Your colony is {RENOWN}, and we will be careful.
[greetings,cordial,colony:infamous] We have heard what is said of your colony. Your letter says something better, and we will remember it.
[help,refusal,colony:infamous] Your colony's name does you no favors here. We will not send {HELP}.
[invitation,cool,colony:infamous] We have read your invitation. With what is said of your colony, we will stay home.
[warning,cool,colony:infamous] We have your warning. From your colony, we will look into it ourselves.
[condolences,cool,colony:infamous] We have your letter. Kind words from your colony were not what we expected.
[greetings,warm,us:knownas] We know you here as {KNOWNAS}, {WRITER}. Your letter is welcome.
[greetings,cordial,us:knownas,theirLowtech] Your name is spoken here, {WRITER}, as {KNOWNAS}. We are glad to have your letter.
[greetings,cordial,us:knownas,theirHightech] Your name is on file with us as {KNOWNAS}, {WRITER}. Good to hear from you.
[greetings,warm,us:knownas:healers] Some here owe their health to you, {WRITER}, and they have not forgotten it.
[greetings,cordial,us:knownas:fighters] Our fighters still talk about you, {WRITER}. Your letter will be read aloud.
[help,warm,us:knownas] For {KNOWNAS}, we send {HELP} gladly.
[invitation,warm,us:knownas] An invitation from {KNOWNAS} is an honor. We will come.
[renownup,us,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] The whole region knows our colony's name now.
[renownup,us,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Strangers across the region know who we are now.
[renownup,us,tribal,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Every fire in the region tells of our camp now, they say.
[renownup,us,tribal,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] The clans of the region speak our name at their fires now.
[renownup,us,medieval,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Our colony is sung of in halls I've never set foot in.
[renownup,us,medieval,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] They say the region's halls know our name now.
[renownup,us,industrial,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] We're in the region's papers, apparently.
[renownup,us,industrial,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Seems the whole region reads about us now.
[renownup,us,spacer,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Every channel in the region carries our name now.
[renownup,us,spacer,colony:renowned,!colony:wide] Our colony's name is on every feed in the region.
[renownup,us,colony:wide] Strangers from every people around know our name now.
[renownup,us,tribal,colony:wide] Clans we have never met tell of our camp now.
[renownup,us,medieval,colony:wide] They sing of our colony in halls far and wide, I'm told.
[renownup,us,industrial,colony:wide] Every people around seems to know our colony's name now.
[renownup,us,spacer,colony:wide] Our name is out past every relay in reach.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:healers] If we're known for our healing now, I hope the hurt know where to find us.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:fighters] I'd rather be known for something besides fighting, but I'll take it.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:hosts] Good, maybe more guests will come knocking.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:traders] Being known for our trading is good for business.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:makers] People know the colony for its work, and the work is what matters.
[renownup,us,colony:knownfor:faithful] I hope our faith is what they remember us by.
[renowndown,us,colony:wasrenowned] For a while the whole region knew our name, and now nobody does.
[renowndown,us,tribal,colony:wasrenowned] The fires of the region have forgotten our name for now.
[renowndown,us,medieval,colony:wasrenowned] The halls sing of other places now.
[renowndown,us,industrial,colony:wasrenowned] The papers have no more use for us.
[renowndown,us,spacer,colony:wasrenowned] The region's channels have moved on from us.
[wordyes,them,colony:renowned] With a name like your colony's, the good word half speaks itself.
[wordyes,them,colony:renowned,theirLowtech] Your colony's name opens doors at home, I'll put in my word too.
[wordyes,them,colony:renowned,theirHightech] A good word for a known name is an easy word to give.
[wordyes,them,colony:known,!colony:renowned] I've heard of your colony, so my word will land on good ground.
[wordyes,them,colony:wide] Your colony's name will do most of the work, I'll only add mine.
